steps.title: Replace, don't add
steps.say: `@Override` says this method **replaces** the parent's version. Everything else (deposit, transfer) still works as before.

marks.label: can go negative, but only this far

steps.title: It just works
steps.say: `transfer` was written in BankAccount, but on a checking account it calls the **overridden** withdraw. That's the power of inheritance.

steps.title: Open CheckingAccount.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `CheckingAccount` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.
